title: Reduce time-to-sign for pricing experiments via standardized redline decisioning and DPA self-serve
creator: Noah Patel
description: Problem: Pricing/packaging experiments are triggering frequent MSA/DPA redlines and bespoke concessions, creating a 2-6 week median sales cycle for mid-market/enterprise deals. We lack an authoritative decisioning workflow to approve liability and indemnity changes, and security questionnaire responses are handled ad hoc. Goal: Create a standardized legal review workflow + templated concession catalog and a self-serve DPA option for common, low-risk packages to reduce review time and improve signal to Legal/Finance when escalations are truly necessary.
acceptance_criteria: A documented redline decision matrix (liability/indemnity/data residency) is published in Confluence and approved by Legal
A concession catalog (tiered by customer size and ARR threshold) with pre-approved offsets (credits, indemnity caps) is available to Sales ops
DPA self-serve flow implemented for two pricing packages and tested with at least 3 customers (pilot) resulting in no legal touch for standard redlines
Legal review SLA established (48 hours for standard requests, 5 business days for escalations) and reliable exceptions tracking is live
Security questionnaire responses are consolidated into a re-usable FAQ + downloadable evidence package to cut repeated questionnaire time by >=40% in pilot
tasks: Workshop with Legal (Rachel Green) to enumerate redline categories and non-negotiables
Draft redline decision matrix and concession catalog (first-pass) and circulate for comment
Implement DPA self-serve templates in CLM (DocuSign/Agiloft) and wire webhook to Salesforce
Create evidence bundle and curated answers for top 10 security questionnaire items
Update Sales playbook + deal desk routing rules and train 10 AE/AMs for pilot
Pilot with 3 existing customers across different regions and capture metrics (time-to-sign, legal touches, concessions used)
Iterate on matrix and push final docs to Confluence and share via internal comms
decision_summary: We will classify redlines into three bands: green (auto-approve with templated offsets), amber (legal review with 48h SLA, use concession catalog), red (exec/legal escalation). For pricing experiments we default to green/amber unless the request changes indemnity, expands liability or requires data residency changes. DPA self-serve will cover two standardized packages representing ~60% of inbound mid-market deals.
